title: Finite projective constant models of etale lisse sheaves
statement: Let $S$ be any scheme and $A$ a finite commutative ring. Let $L$ be an $A$-module sheaf on the small etale site of $S$ which is locally constant and whose geometric stalk at every separably closed point is a finite projective $A$-module [def-constructible-locally-constant, def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks, det-sf-flat-model-generation]. There is an etale locally constant datum for $L$ on which every constant module model is finitely generated and projective over $A$. More precisely, on each member $U_i$ the restricted module sheaf is isomorphic to the constant sheaf of a module $P_i$, with Module.Finite A P_i and Module.Projective A P_i. The empty scheme is included.

proof.text: Take a locally constant datum and restrict its cover to the members with nonempty underlying scheme. Every point still has a covering lift, so this is a cover; the same constant trivializations restrict to it. On an empty scheme this yields an empty cover.

proof.text: Choose a point in each remaining member and the algebraic closure of its residue field. The moreover clause of the existing finite-values theorem gives a module isomorphism from the corresponding geometric stalk of L to the constant module for this specified datum. Use that public theorem, without accessing its private construction. Finiteness transports across its underlying equivalence, and projectivity transports across its linear equivalence; finiteness of the underlying set implies finite generation.

lean.statement:
theorem lisseProjective_constantModels
    {S : Scheme.{u}} (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (L : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))
    (hL : FlatModelEtaleLisseProjective A L) :
    ∃ d : Scheme.LocallyConstantDatum L, ∀ i : d.cover.I₀,
      ∃ P : ModuleCat.{u + 1} A, Module.Finite A P ∧ Module.Projective A P ∧
        Nonempty (L.over (d.cover.etalePrecoverageToEtale i) ≅
          (constantSheaf (S.smallEtaleTopology.over (d.cover.etalePrecoverageToEtale i))
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)).obj P)
